name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Fungus goes with Bauer or Bauer goes with Navigator.
Between Medic and Navigator, one goes with Anders and the other with Cho.
Exactly one of these is true: Anders goes with Diatoms; Bauer goes with Pilot; Cho goes with Medic.

hints.text: Suppose Bauer went with Navigator — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Bauer goes with Navigator.
Navigator goes with Bauer, so Anders can't go with Navigator.
Navigator goes with Bauer, so Cho can't go with Navigator.
…but now the clue “Between Medic and Navigator, one goes with Anders and the other with Cho” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Bauer does not go with Navigator.
